_meta.name: backward_selection
_meta.description: Backward elimination: REG_OLS with selection backward starts from every predictor and drops the one whose removal improves BIC most, stopping when no removal does. On survey.pulse, q4 on the other five items ends with q3, q5 and q6 and drops q1 and q2, the same model as 13_forward_selection.json and 11_stepwise.json here. Selection buffers the request.
